title: batatas glabra
intro: Batatas glabra, commonly known as the blind root or devil's backbone, is a plant species that belongs to the family Lamiaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis, digestive issues, and anxiety. The therapeutic actions of Batatas glabra include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic agent, making it useful for wound healing and skin care. The bioactive constituents of Batatas glabra include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a subject of interest for further research.
